items.risk: Wafer-fab equipment remains cyclical and geographically exposed to customer capex and export controls.
Current margins may be sensitive to mix, cycle conditions and trade restrictions.
China was 34% of FY2026 revenue, creating material geopolitical/export-control sensitivity.
WFE customer capex cycles can overwhelm secular process-intensity gains over shorter periods.
Four >=10% customers collectively represent a majority of FY2026 revenue, increasing bargaining and timing risk.
China exposure is material and subject to changing U.S. export controls.
High current margins can normalize downward with product mix, WFE cycle or trade restrictions.
